License plate logo texture removed from adapted model. Original license and metadata included alongside this file.

Modifications: decoded and baked static transforms, removed AMG display stage, normalized scale and orientation, merged static material groups, neutralized paint texture colors for player tinting, added paint/matte controls and body-fitted stripe/wing geometry, generated simplified distant models and rendered preview images. Close models retain original triangle detail; textures retain original source resolution. Embedded attribution metadata remains in exported GLBs. Fictional in-game car names do not imply endorsement by model creators or vehicle manufacturers. Licenses cover the model copyrights and do not grant trademark rights.
